sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238904
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 23540 of 2023

Applicant :- Kanhaiya
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Mukesh Kumar Upadhyay,Virendra Kumar Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Anita Singh,Prem Babu Verma,Shailendra Singh
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri V.K. Srivastava, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Shailendra Singh and Sri Prem Babu Verma, learned counsels for the informant and Sri Pradeep Kumar, learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 134 of 2023, under Sections 376, 354B IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Shahganj, District Agra during pendency of the trial.
3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and according to the FIR applicant inserted his finger in the vagina of the daughter of the informant aged about 11 years.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and actually applicant has given Rs. 50,000/- as loan to the informant but informant was not returning his money and when he demanded back his money strictly then she implicated him in the present matter.

sentences.text:
5. He further submits that however victim in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. stated against the applicant but she is hardly 11-13 years old girl, therefore,
under pressure of her mother i.e. informant she stated against the applicant.
6. He further submits that even medical report of the victim does not corroborate the prosecution case.
He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 02.04.2023 i.e. for more than six months.

7. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsels appearing on behalf of the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that victim is hardly 13 years old girl and she in her both the statements recorded during investigation stated that applicant inserted his finger in her vagina and applicant could not bring any good reason for his false implication, therefore, he does not deserve bail.
8. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. From the record, it reflects that victim is hardly 11-13 years old and she in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. categorically stated that applicant inserted his finger in her vagina, however, applicant tried to show his false implication and he make an averment in this regard in paragraph-8 of the affidavit but from its perusal it reflects that it is vague and general in nature and in my view, merely on the basis of such defence, the statements of the victim recorded during investigation cannot be discarded at this stage.

10. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.
11. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is rejected.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 16.12.2023 AK Pandey  Kanhaiya vs State Of U.P.And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34269311/
